deferred.name: dolt_reset('--hard') commits the active SQL transaction
deferred.reason: Intended divergence (D5): prolly's version-control operations are transactional and roll back with their transaction, so a hard reset doesn't commit the active SQL transaction as Dolt's does. The adapter runs typed operations only on idle sessions; a port would have to insert a COMMIT that erases the assertion.

deferred.name: dolt_reset(rev) moves HEAD, resets the index, and leaves the working tree alone
deferred.reason: Not applicable (D1): a mixed reset moves HEAD and resets the index while keeping the working tree; prolly has no index and only does hard resets.

deferred.name: hard reset inserted rows continues auto increment
deferred.reason: Intended divergence: a versioned schema's sequences are per branch and recorded in each commit, so a hard reset restores the commit's value and the next generated key is 3, not Dolt's 5 (D6). Dolt keeps its auto-increment counter outside the working set.

deferred.name: CALL DOLT_RESET('--hard') should reset the merge state after uncommitted merge
deferred.reason: Needs cell-wise merge: the setup's merge edits different columns of one row, which Dolt merges and prolly reports as a conflict. Ported once prolly merges cell-wise.
